Enrich person.name: Jim Freeman
Enrich person.title: Executive Vice President | Head of Stock Plan Services
Enrich person.summary:
I firmly believe that successful people and organizations share one critical attribute; they find it far more important to listen than to be heard. I’ve had the privilege of spending more than 30 years at Fidelity Investments serving both clients and prospective clients and working alongside phenomenal colleagues. 

Throughout my time here, it’s become clear that prioritizing active listening, being empathetic to others’ needs, and maintaining a passion for supporting our customers’ success is the clearest path to delivering world-class service and being the best leader and colleague I can be. 

As a member of Fidelity’s Workplace Investing senior leadership team, I focus my time on challenging my team to hone their listening skills and to develop an ever-deeper understanding of our customers’ unique needs. This, in turn, helps us identify the right Fidelity solutions that will help our clients in meeting those unique needs.

I’m proud to be a part of an organization that consistently delivers customer-centric solutions and service to our clients and their employees while supporting our associates to be their very best.
